verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators for FIDO2/U2F, PIV and OTP. A user-defined, event-triggered automation rules engine falls outside this product category. HOTP auto-typing via HID keyboard emulation is a fixed authentication behavior, not user-defined rules, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
